name: Application is reachable
script:
from sdk import http, result

with http('/') as response:
    assert response.status == 200, f'Homepage returned HTTP {response.status}'
    assert response.read(1024), 'Homepage is empty'
result('passed', 'The deployed homepage responds with HTTP 200 and a non-empty body.')

name: Signup button works
description: The signup control opens the expected form.
script:
import re
from sdk import BASE_URL, CONFIG, browser_page, result

with browser_page() as page:
    page.goto(BASE_URL, wait_until='domcontentloaded')
    # Set signup_selector when your app uses a different label or control.
    control = page.locator(CONFIG['signup_selector']) if CONFIG.get('signup_selector') else page.get_by_role('button', name=re.compile(r'sign up|create account|get started', re.I))
    control.first.click()
    # A click alone is not a pass: assert that the signup form appears.
    page.locator(CONFIG.get('signup_form_selector', 'input[type="email"]')).wait_for(state='visible')
result('passed', 'The signup control opens a form with the expected input.')

name: CPU and memory stay healthy for one hour
description: Uses timestamped monitoring data after deployment.
script:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from sdk import CONTEXT, CONFIG, DEPLOYMENT_REF, json_endpoint, timestamp, result, require_config

require_config('metrics_url')
deployed = timestamp(CONTEXT['deployed_at'])
now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
# This window begins after deployment, not one hour before it.
if (now - deployed).total_seconds() < 3600:
    result('observing', 'Waiting for one complete hour of post-deployment CPU/memory metrics. The worker will check again.')
data = json_endpoint('metrics_url')
assert data['deployment_ref'] == DEPLOYMENT_REF, 'Metrics belong to a different deployment'
samples = sorted(data.get('samples', []), key=lambda s: timestamp(s['timestamp']))
if len(samples) < 13:
    result('inconclusive', 'Need at least 13 timestamped CPU/memory samples covering the last hour.')
times = [timestamp(s['timestamp']) for s in samples]
assert times[0] >= deployed, 'Metrics include a previous deployment window'
if (times[-1] - times[0]).total_seconds() < 3600:
    result('inconclusive', 'Metrics do not cover a full hour after deployment.')
assert 0 <= (now - times[-1]).total_seconds() <= 120, 'Metrics are stale or in the future'
assert all(0 < (b-a).total_seconds() <= 300 for a,b in zip(times,times[1:])), 'Metrics contain missing or duplicate intervals'
assert (now - times[0]).total_seconds() <= 3900, 'Metrics do not describe the latest hour'
for sample in samples:
    assert 0 <= sample['cpu_percent'] <= CONFIG.get('max_cpu_percent', 80), 'CPU crossed the threshold'
    assert 0 <= sample['memory_percent'] <= CONFIG.get('max_memory_percent', 85), 'Memory crossed the threshold'
result('passed', 'CPU and memory stayed within configured limits for a complete post-deployment hour.')

name: Active users are healthy
description: Uses live activity and error-rate telemetry.
script:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from sdk import CONTEXT, CONFIG, DEPLOYMENT_REF, json_endpoint, timestamp, result

# Adapter endpoint contract is documented in runner/README.md.
data = json_endpoint('active_users_url')
assert data['deployment_ref'] == DEPLOYMENT_REF, 'Activity belongs to another deployment'
start, end = timestamp(data['window_start']), timestamp(data['window_end'])
assert start >= timestamp(CONTEXT['deployed_at']) and end > start, 'Activity is not from this deployment window'
assert 0 <= (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - end).total_seconds() <= 120, 'Activity metrics are stale'
if data['active_users'] == 0:
    result('inconclusive', 'No active users observed; live-user health cannot be established.')
assert data['active_users'] > 0, 'Invalid active-user count'
assert 0 <= data['error_rate'] <= CONFIG.get('max_error_rate', 0.01), 'Live-user error rate is above the threshold'
result('passed', f"Observed {data['active_users']} active users with error rate within the configured threshold.")

name: Active traffic reaches the new deployment
description: Uses request and session routing telemetry.
script:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from sdk import CONTEXT, DEPLOYMENT_REF, json_endpoint, timestamp, result

# The adapter must aggregate real request/session deployment identities.
# A successful homepage request alone does not establish session migration.
data = json_endpoint('routing_url')
assert data['deployment_ref'] == DEPLOYMENT_REF, 'Routing metrics refer to another deployment'
start, end = timestamp(data['window_start']), timestamp(data['window_end'])
assert start >= timestamp(CONTEXT['deployed_at']) and end > start, 'Routing window predates this deployment'
assert 0 <= (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - end).total_seconds() <= 120, 'Routing metrics are stale'
if data['requests_new'] == 0 or data['active_sessions_new'] == 0:
    result('inconclusive', 'Need observed requests and active sessions reaching the new deployment.')
assert data['requests_new'] > 0 and data['active_sessions_new'] > 0, 'Invalid request/session counts'
assert data['requests_old'] == 0, 'Requests still reach the previous deployment'
assert data['active_sessions_old'] == 0, 'Active sessions still reach the previous deployment'
result('passed', 'All requests and active sessions in the reported window reached the new deployment.')
